title: Ohm Brew Double Brew Strawberry Banana 100ml Shortfill
description: Ohm Brew Double Brew Strawberry Banana is a classic, comforting fruit smoothie blend. The inhale introduces the sweet, garden-fresh notes of ripe Strawberry, seamlessly melting into the rich, creamy texture of Banana on the exhale. This creates a velvety and delicious fruit vape. Unlike traditional high-VG shortfill e-liquids, this blend features a balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio. This highly versatile formulation means it performs flawlessly in Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) refillable pod kits and pen-style devices, as well as Sub-Ohm setups at lower wattages (16-22W). The Double Brew range is richly formulated with nearly twice the standard flavour concentrate, ensuring an incredibly intense and vivid taste regardless of your chosen device. Supplied in a 120ml bottle containing 100ml of 0mg nicotine e-liquid, there is space to add two 10ml nicotine shots. Adding two 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Crafted in Belfast, UK, Ohm Brew guarantees premium quality and highly authentic flavour profiles that run the gamut from timeless classics to innovative new flavours found nowhere else.
